title: Litigation Paralegal
summary: A litigation paralegal (legal executive) supports advocates on court cases by keeping case files, filing papers in court registries and online, and tracking hearing dates. They work in a law firm's litigation team or a company's legal department, and do research and first drafts but do not argue in court.
dailyDuties: Maintain case files, briefs and order sheets for active matters
File petitions and documents through court e-filing portals and registries
Check daily cause lists and update the hearing diary
Draft first versions of legal notices and replies
Research judgments on SCC Online or Manupatra
Prepare paper books, indexes and affidavits for filing
Update the litigation tracker and MIS for clients or management

skills.expectation: Maintain case files, briefs, order sheets and the matter diary
File pleadings through court e-filing portals and clear registry objections
Check daily cause lists and keep hearing dates up to date
Draft first versions of legal notices and replies for review
Find judgments on SCC Online or Manupatra and prepare case law compilations
Review and index documents and evidence for a matter
Keep litigation trackers and MIS up to date in Excel
Coordinate clearly with advocates, clients and court staff
Prepare affidavits, paper books, indexes and simple applications
Coordinate matters with panel or external advocates
Support cheque bounce and recovery matters for lenders
